hooks.command: p=$(cat); h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks"; [ "$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r -f "$h/role.jq")" = executor ] && printf '%s' "$p" | jq -e -f "$h/writes-tests.jq" >/dev/null && { echo 'The executor does not edit tests; ask the test-engineer to change them.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

[ "$PET_HELPER_HELD_OUT" = 1 ] || ! jq -e -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/held-out.jq" >/dev/null || { echo 'Held-out eval cases are hidden from agents that change the assistant; run them only through the accept/reject step.' >&2; exit 2; }

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$(dirname "$f")" || exit 2; uv run --quiet prek run ruff-format ruff-check --files "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || out=$(uv run --quiet prek run ruff-format ruff-check --files "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; }

[ "$(jq -r -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/role.jq")" = executor ] || exit 0; w=$(sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/flow.sh" get worktree 2>/dev/null); cd "${w:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" || exit 2; out=$(uv run --quiet prek run --all-files 2>&1 && uv run --quiet prek run --all-files --stage pre-push 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -25 >&2; exit 2; }
